interpretations: For tracks with `Bytes > 10,323,804`, calculate each media type’s average of the individual track ratios `Bytes ÷ Milliseconds`. Return the media type name, that average, and its difference from the unweighted average of the qualifying media types’ averages, including only media types whose average is strictly greater. Leave the values unrounded.
queries:
WITH media_averages AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_ratio
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
)
SELECT media_type_name,
       average_ratio,
       average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM media_averages) AS difference
FROM media_averages
WHERE average_ratio > (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM media_averages)
